questions.section: SECTION 2: DIRECT QUESTIONS – ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS (60 POINTS)
questions.question: 41. Explain 2 characteristics of human wants? (4 mark).
questions.answer_guide: Any two: human wants are unlimited (insatiable); they are recurrent (repeat, e.g. hunger); they are complementary (one want leads to another, e.g. car and fuel); they are competitive (compete for limited income); they vary with time, place and person; some become habits.

questions.section: SECTION 2: DIRECT QUESTIONS – ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS (60 POINTS)
questions.question: 42. Demonstrate the importance of business studies in the society? (4 mark).
questions.answer_guide: It equips people with knowledge and skills to start and run businesses; creates entrepreneurs and jobs; helps people manage personal finances and make good consumer decisions; promotes understanding of trade, banking and the economy; encourages self-reliance and national development.

questions.question:
44. State four characteristics of good business idea? (4 mark).
   (Note: the paper numbers this question 44 a second time.)
questions.answer_guide: Any four: meets a real need/solves a problem; has a market (enough customers); is profitable; is affordable/feasible with available resources and skills; is unique or innovative; is legal and ethical; is sustainable.

questions.question: 45. Highlight 4 Ps of marketing mix? (4 mark).

questions.section: SECTION 2: DIRECT QUESTIONS – ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS (60 POINTS)
questions.question:
46. Give Two differences between business idea and business opportunities? (4 mark).
   (Note: question 47 is not printed on the paper.)
questions.answer_guide:
A business idea is just a thought or concept for a product/service; a business opportunity is an idea that has been tested and shown to be attractive, viable and profitable in the market.
A business idea may not have a market or resources yet; an opportunity has demand, timing and resources available to exploit it.

questions.section: SECTION 2: DIRECT QUESTIONS – ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS (60 POINTS)
questions.question: 54. Distinguish between Private and Public Organizations. (4 mark).
questions.answer_guide: Private organizations are owned and controlled by individuals or groups of private persons, aim mainly at profit and are financed by owners/shareholders. Public organizations are owned and controlled by the government, aim mainly to provide services to the public, and are financed by public funds (taxes).

questions.section: SECTION 2: DIRECT QUESTIONS – ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS (60 POINTS)
questions.question: 55. Compare between strategic planning and tactical planning in terms of time. (4 mark).
questions.answer_guide: Strategic planning is long-term (usually 3–5 years or more), done by top management for the whole organization. Tactical planning is short- to medium-term (usually up to 1–2 years), done by middle management to carry out parts of the strategic plan.
